title: c-VEP dataset from Thielen et al. (2015)
description: A preprocessed EEG dataset from a brain-computer interface study using broad-band visually evoked potentials (BBVEP) for a 6×6 matrix speller application. The dataset comprises 12 healthy participants performing online BCI tasks with visual stimulation using modulated Gold codes, achieving an average accuracy of 86% and information transfer rate of 48 bits per minute. Data were acquired at 2048 Hz from 64 EEG channels and preprocessed with filtering, downsampling, and common average referencing.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 12 participants using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 64 active electrodes at 2048 Hz sampling rate. The experimental paradigm employed a 6×6 matrix speller with visual stimulation using modulated Gold codes (126-bit sequences, 1.05s duration). Participants performed three runs of copy-spelling tasks with 36 trials per run. Data were preprocessed including downsampling to 360 Hz, linear de-trending, common average referencing, and bandpass filtering (5-100 Hz with notch filtering at 50 Hz). Classification used template matching with correlation and Canonical Correlation Analysis for spatial filtering.
